decisions.rule: Accept +1 Notoriety; choose an owned, unevolved spell instance with Resonance <2 and grant +1 Resonance (max 2); if none eligible, next table begins with +1 Aether up to cap 3. On first Velvet Arena hand publicly disclose the ID of one randomly selected spell drawn into own opening spell hand; tell is public, poker cards stay private. Choice/events seeded and saved once.

Select a public poker dossier for Witness Arden OR Livia Shade from up to 12 recorded public hands, with sample size shown. Include recorded VPIP/PFR/shoves; never claim exact lifetime stats or disclose unrevealed cards. HUD dossier persists at Velvet Arena and then expires. Personal witnessed histories may also be read. No wallet changes.

Alive top-two gets +1 Favor and a Cinder Pass flag exactly once; alive lower than top-two gets -1 Favor, no additional chip loss or Keeper Audit; zero triggers Last Claim per existing one-rescue rule. Dead or zero-wallet regular replaced only by once-funded substitute.
Existing 96-chip external ingress remains: Osric 60, Ash Porter 18, Cinder Mason 18, unused balances in source account; account must exist before transfers. Never remint on reload.
Free means no outstanding debt and no unfulfilled service covenant. Unbound Mercy is not a binding obligation; an overdue-but-unpaid debt is still binding.

P5 may retain Mask Falls ending for existing saves; from P6, free survivors can seek Crown Writ via one nonchip petition (-1 Favor, min -3), no Act II replay; bound survivors continue Undercircuit and may earn a conditional writ while obligations persist.
Each rival uses 3/3 primary pair and 1/1 other disciplines; Margrave Noct substitutes one Briar Lock with Thorn Lattice; Ash Porter and Cinder Mason use beginner Spellbook.

Masked Salon winner selects one seeded non-owned relic (replacement allowed when full) OR +1 Resonance to one owned unevolved spell (max 2). Velvet Arena winner selects a non-owned relic OR one evolution token with existing fallback; all rewards non-chip, collected once.

Allow voluntary wallet-funded NPC repayment on each unique completed act boundary and single Cinder Hearing boundary; record actId+obligationId and preserve at least one Lifechip. No idle-time passive payments, no double credits. Creditor death routes funds to named estate, not void.
